results.name: 19th century gravestone
results.description: I've passed by this particular gravestone many times when I visited Mount Pleasant Cemetery. It is broken and was covered with green lichen. The lichen made it difficult to see what was inscribed on the stone. I brought an ice cream bucket and a scrub brush with me to clean off the lichen. I used only water from the tap nearby and gentely removed the lichen. After several rinses and scrubs, the lichen was largely removed. I did skip the lichen at the grass-line as it didn't interfere with the photography. I used the Halide camera app on my iPhone XS Max to capture DNGs to convert to TIFs for use in Metashape. I used the "High" setting in Metashape to make the model. I did some light editing in Meshmixer, then imported the OBJ back into Metashape to create the texture.
results.creator: jerryfisher

results.name: North Japanese-Style Pagoda
results.description: At Terrace Park in Sioux Falls, SD, are a pair of Japanese inspired pagodas built into the side of the hill rising east above Covell Lake. They are part of the historic Japanese Gardens, which was designed by Joseph Maddox and built by the WPA from 1928-1932. The gardens have had a rise, fall, and rise again over the intervening decades. They were vandalized at the start of WWII and fell into decline as resources were diverted. They became overgrown and were neglected. Starting in the 1960s repairs were carried out but the gardens were not fully replanted until the 1980s-1990s. They are a cherished part of the city park system today. This model is of the northern pagoda, created from 4K video shot on an iPhone XS Max and processed through PhotoCatch. The exported DAE was trimmed down in Meshlab. There are multiple mistakes in the model but that is my fault for being in a hurry and not getting adequate coverage above the pagoda. I will try to model it better in the future.
